<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 182.073 Da. This corresponds to the M+1 isotopic peak of a molecule whose monoisotopic mass is about 181.07 Da, which matches the formula C₆H₁₂O₆ (glucose). The isotopic pattern (M+1, M+2 intensities) is consistent with a six‑carbon compound. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound in the sample is C6H12O6.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H12O6</final_answer>
